_comment: Curated source list. status: current | needs_verification (official and still linked, but predates or may not reflect the Electoral Act 2026) | historical | superseded. publication_date_basis says how the date is known; null dates mean unknown and must stay null.

documents.title: Electoral Act, 2026
documents.organisation: Federal Republic of Nigeria (published by INEC)
documents.description: The law governing Federal, State and FCT Area Council elections. It repeals the Electoral Act No. 13, 2022.

documents.title: Regulations and Guidelines for the Conduct of Elections, 2026
documents.description: INEC's main handbook on accreditation, voting, collation and polling unit management. This is a scanned PDF, so its text was read by OCR and may contain small errors.

documents.title: Request for Application to Serve as Observer Groups for 2027 General Election
documents.description: How observer groups apply and are accredited for the 2027 general election, including the application deadline.

documents.title: Voter Education & Guidelines
documents.publication_date_basis: Live page with no stated date; see retrieval date
documents.description: INEC's live voter education page: how to vote, rights and duties, inclusion, offences and collation of results. Its offences section cites the repealed Electoral Act 2022, so check penalties against the Electoral Act 2026.

documents.title: Frequently Asked Questions (Voter FAQs)
documents.publication_date_basis: Live page with no stated date; see retrieval date
documents.description: INEC's live answers to common questions on registration, PVCs, election day, results and offences. Some details, such as penalties, may not reflect the Electoral Act 2026.

documents.title: Full Election Calendar & Timetable
documents.publication_date_basis: Live page with no stated date; see retrieval date
documents.description: Official schedule of upcoming general, governorship and bye-elections.

documents.title: INEC Continuous Voter Registration Portal: Status Notice
documents.publication_date_basis: Live page with no stated date; see retrieval date
documents.description: The front page of INEC's voter registration portal, including any notice on whether registration is open.

documents.title: INEC Continuous Voter Registration Portal: Services
documents.publication_date_basis: Live page with no stated date; see retrieval date
documents.description: INEC's description of portal services: pre-registration, transfer, information update, PVC collection and replacement.

documents.title: Election Procedure (Voting Procedure and Election Day Guide)
documents.description: Step-by-step election day guide. INEC still links it, but it predates the Electoral Act 2026.

documents.title: Procedure for Electronic Transmission and Collation of Results
documents.publication_date_basis: PDF file creation date (not a stated publication date)
documents.description: Manual on uploading polling unit results with BVAS and collating them. INEC still links it, but it predates the Electoral Act 2026.

documents.title: Revised Framework and Regulations for Voting by Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs)
documents.description: How internally displaced persons vote. It predates the Electoral Act 2026. This is a scanned PDF, read by OCR.

documents.title: Regulations and Guidelines for the Conduct of Elections, 2022
documents.description: Earlier regulations, kept for reference only. The 2026 edition replaces them.

documents.title: Regulations and Guidelines for the Conduct of Elections, 2019
documents.description: Earlier regulations, kept for reference only. Later editions replace them.

documents.title: Electoral Offences and Penalties (Handbill, February 2019)
documents.publication_date_basis: Month and year in official file name
documents.description: A 2019 summary of offences, written before the Electoral Act 2026. Check penalties against the current Act.

documents.title: Continuous Voter Registration Guide
documents.publication_date_basis: PDF file creation date (not a stated publication date)
documents.description: A registration guide from about 2013, kept for background. Procedures may have changed.

documents.title: INEC Guidelines for Registration of Voters
documents.publication_date_basis: PDF file creation date (not a stated publication date)
documents.description: Registration guidelines from about 2013, kept for background. Procedures may have changed.

documents.title: Press Release: Conduct of Supplementary Elections (27 March 2023)
documents.description: A press release about the April 2023 supplementary elections. It is about those polls only.
